      • findMissingSpotList

        public MissingSpotList findMissingSpotList(int spotListType,
                                  Long telescopeId,
                                  Long pupilMaskTypeId)
        Queries database for a missing spot list given the spot list type, telescope and pupil mask type
        Parameters:
        spotListType - missing from F&I or not to be used for analysis
        telescopeId - Keck 1 or Keck 2
        pupilMaskTypeId - the pupil mask type, such as fine screen, passive tilt, phasing or SUFS
        Returns:
        the list of missing spots

      • findMissingSpotList

        public MissingSpotList findMissingSpotList(int spotListType,
                                  Long telescopeId,
                                  Long pupilMaskTypeId,
                                  int sufsGroup)
        Queries database for a missing spot list given the spot list type, telescope, pupil mask type, and SUFS Group
        Parameters:
        spotListType - missing from F&I or not to be used for analysis
        telescopeId - Keck 1 or Keck 2
        pupilMaskTypeId - the pupil mask type, such as fine screen, passive tilt, phasing or SUFS
        sufsGroup - the SUFS group to use for missing spots
        Returns:
        the list of missing spots
